description: This Java class defines a JPA entity representing an email message within a system, including fields for sender, recipients, subject, body, status flags, folder location, timestamps, and database indexing details.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: JPA entity class representing an email message with various attributes such as sender, recipients, subject, body, status flags, folder, timestamps, and indexing for database queries.

classes.name: Folder
classes.description: Enumeration defining the logical folders an email can reside in: INBOX, SENT, DRAFTS, TRASH, ARCHIVED.
